confirmed_primary_corrections.note: September 2 2025 was pricing; actual second distinct public offering closed September 4 2025, first March financing final tranche closed March 18, 2025. Already corrected in financing-status data.
Single May 11, 2026 financed close SEC 6-K independently verified in targeted recheck. Two post-readout financing closes NOT verified.
Issuer IR release May 8, 2026 closing $805m gross; SEC May 2026 8-K separately records net proceeds. Still independently validate two post-readout sequence.
2026 10-Q describes completed October 2025 PIPE (~$500 million); an inferred October 31 exact settlement date is NOT by itself validated.
Company report holds cash and Treasury holdings; independent cash flow and liquidity runway not yet certified.
SEC reports EUR-denominated cash and operating burn. Verifying USD cash from SEC Companyfacts is not applicable without currency-aware IFRS parsing, keep financial gate hold.

note: This is a research disposition audit. It does NOT automatically remove missing mandatory evidence or promote a trade. Reconciliation must verify source primary records with timestamps, exact issuer and content hashes. Ineligible-for-Phase3 and ownership mismatches must be reported separately from missing evidence, not rewritten as successful financing closings.
